description: fleet-hosted (#12583, component C of #9081): the hosted fleet front door — one Cloudflare Worker with route modules for the stamping, query, queue, ingestion and sync doors over one auth/tenancy plumbing layer. Real: RP-token auth validation, tenancy mapping, health/capabilities (#12583), the session registry (#12584), stamp signatures (#12586), the stamping create path (#12585), the Metadata query surface (#12587), the queue front door (#12589), the ingestion receiver + sweeper (#12590), and the sync door (#12591) — every component-C door is live, plus the direct-Turso read path's token mint + scope inspector (#12592) and the thin TS CLI that carries callers to all of them (#12588). Local-only; no deployment.
name: fleet-hosted
